title: Addresses outside the reserved regions
statement: Let $W$ be a natural number, let $	ext{lim}$ be a record of word, space, and depth limits, let $P$ be a light program, let $p_0$ be a natural number, and let $	ext{dec}$ be a Boolean. Assume the word size fits the limits, the pool bound $	ext{dispPos}(P,	ext{dec})$, and the stack size $	ext{mainFrame}+(	ext{frameSize}(P)+1)(	ext{lim.depth}+1)$. For any integer $a$, if $a<-	ext{lowCell}(P,	ext{dec},	ext{lim})$ or $	ext{lim.space}\le a$, then $a$ belongs to none of the following: the union of the constants for pool bound $	ext{dispPos}(P,	ext{dec})$, the frame pointer and main-frame addresses for frame size $	ext{frameSize}(P)$, the writable addresses of the generated size configuration at stack index $	ext{mainFrame}$, and the result and difference-register addresses.
